title: Structure of a B-DNA dodecamer: conformation and dynamics
authors: Drew HR, Wing RM, Takano T, Broka C, Tanaka S, Itakura K, et al.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
population: Single crystals of the synthetic DNA dodecamer d(CpGpCpGpApApTpTpCpGpCpG)
funder: This work was carried out with the support of National Institutes of Health Grants GM-12121 and GM-24393 and National Science Foundation Grant PCM79-13959. H.R.D. was the recipient of a National Institutes of Health Predoctoral Traineeship.
authorConflicts: None stated. S. Tanaka's present address is given as the Suntory Institute for Biomedical Research, Osaka.
result: The crystal structure of the synthetic dodecamer, refined to a residual error of 17.8% at 1.9 A resolution, is a right-handed Watson-Crick B double helix with an average of 10.1 base pairs per turn over the entire helix; coordinates were deposited with the Brookhaven Protein Data Bank.
